basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and sci-fi enthusiast from the outskirts of Chicago. As a recent college graduate with a degree in digital media, I'm currently freelancing as a graphic designer. I love diving into the world of video games, especially those with rich narratives like Star Wars Squadrons. When I'm not gaming, you can find me crate-digging for vaporwave records or binge-watching documentaries. I'm single, and my usual online hours are late evenings to early mornings, thanks to my night owl tendencies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in digital media, having learned the ropes through my college education and a few online courses. My interest in gaming and technology is mostly self-taught, fueled by countless hours spent troubleshooting games and exploring digital art.
